witnesses.claim: A session changed through CLI resumes through chat at the same revision and digest.
witnesses.required_observation: Create, open, record, confirmed save, process restart, chat resume, exact snapshot equality.

witnesses.claim: Two writers cannot silently lose a confirmed update.
witnesses.required_observation: Two commands share one expected revision; exactly one commits and the other returns revision-conflict with current revision.
Repeat one command_id and payload; return the prior outcome with no second state transition or event.

witnesses.claim: A failed save never appears complete.
witnesses.required_observation: Inject storage failure; last confirmed snapshot remains unchanged and the interface shows unsaved state.

witnesses.claim: Visibility does not become decision authority.
witnesses.required_observation: Authenticated but unauthorized actor can inspect allowed data but cannot record an authoritative answer or export beyond scope.
Audit records contain IDs, revision, outcome, latency, and failure class but no answer text, prompt text, or source content.

witnesses.claim: The current question and recovery actions are operable across interfaces.
witnesses.required_observation: Keyboard-only CLI/chat review plus selected assistive-technology checks against owner-approved criteria.

witnesses.claim: The exact DomainSpec source compiles under an admitted profile.
witnesses.required_observation: Owner-admitted compiler/profile run over the package-local project with a digest-bound conformance receipt.
Rebuild the same session command sequence from pinned inputs and compare snapshot, events, pack, and receipts byte-for-byte.

witnesses.claim: Context sources are applied in the committed order without inference overwriting explicit context.
witnesses.required_observation: Exercise explicit user context, related references, current-window candidates, and saved-session candidates with conflicts; verify provenance, precedence, and user correction remain visible.

witnesses.claim: Only sufficient context continues the Define job.
witnesses.required_observation: Run frozen sufficient, insufficient, and indeterminate fixtures; sufficient continues within the existing authority ceiling, while the other outcomes preserve residue and emit one additional-context invitation.

witnesses.claim: The Define evaluator adapter preserves the bounded semantic witness contract.
witnesses.required_observation: For identical frozen requests, compare byte-identical results and receipts; prove no authority is granted and no model, tool, or effect is rerun during historical replay.

claim_ceiling: Planned witnesses are Design artifacts only; none has executed and none supplies Plan or runtime evidence.
